newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada set special purchase and resale agreements at 3.25 percent in the Canadian money market after the overnight financing rate hit the ceiling of the central bank's 50 basis point range at 3.25 percent, traders said.
They said the overnight rate, also called the call loan rate rose due to pressure from settlements from the weekly Tuesday Government of Canada auction.

Traders said the rate fell slightly from 3.25 percent after the intervention but is expected to come under renewed pressure to rise again. Canada's three-month T-bill yield was down one basis point at 2.99 percent from Wednesday's close.
